title: How to Research a Nonprofit in 5 Minutes

slides.headline: How to Research a Nonprofit in 5 Minutes
slides.subheadline: A free walkthrough using public IRS data on Daanaa

slides.label: Step 1
slides.headline: Search 1.7M organizations
slides.accent_label: Search by name, cause, or location
slides.story: Every active 501(c)(3) in the U.S. is in the directory. Type a name you know, a cause you care about, or your own town. No account needed.
slides.source: IRS Business Master File, updated continuously

slides.label: Step 2
slides.headline: Read the financial context
slides.accent_label: Funding model, health signal, and true peers
slides.story: Each organization page shows how it is funded, how its finances compare to real peers of the same size and model, and where the numbers come from. Context, not scores out of context.
slides.source: IRS 990 filings via ProPublica, public record

slides.label: Step 3
slides.headline: Compare side by side
slides.accent_label: Up to 4 organizations in one view
slides.story: Weighing similar organizations? Put them next to each other. Same data, same layout, no ranking. You see the differences and decide what matters.
slides.source: All data from public IRS filings

slides.label: Step 4
slides.headline: Save privately as you go
slides.accent_label: Your Giving Wallet stays on your device
slides.story: Bookmark organizations and note your giving intent. Nothing is public, nothing is tracked, and no account is required. Your giving is your business.

slides.headline: Five minutes to informed giving
body_lines: Public data on 1.7M nonprofits, made readable.
Free. Private. No rankings, no agenda.
